role: District Representative · Zamboanga del Norte, 3rd District
summary: Zamboanga del Norte 3rd District representative with a very large bill portfolio, mostly school, road and local-facility measures. Notable principal bills: FOI implementation, an independent commission on flood-control fund misuse, confidential-fund safeguards, anti-poverty acceleration for poorest provinces. Co-authored anti-dynasty bill. Filed resolutions probing flood-control corruption.
caveat: Many bills are local facilities, not ideology. Economic score rests on two issues; democratic score rests on bills and resolutions, not votes.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Private-school voucher program (market-leaning) offset by public schools in disadvantaged areas and a tertiary subsidy (net mixed, 0); national program for poorest provinces (-3). Two issues, limited tax or labor evidence.

sources.text: House member page, authored bills: HB04744, HB04745, HB08476, HB07452 (retrieved 2026-11-01)

social.label: Insufficient evidence
social.rationale: Fewer than two adequately evidenced issues in the sources reviewed; left unscored.

sources.text: House member page, authored bills: no scorable evidence in reviewed bills (retrieved 2026-11-01)

civil.label: Insufficient evidence
civil.rationale: Fewer than two adequately evidenced issues in the sources reviewed; left unscored.

democratic.label: Institution-supporting
democratic.rationale: Principal author of FOI (HB02897, HB09397), an independent flood-control investigation commission with subpoena powers, and confidential-fund audit safeguards; co-authored anti-dynasty; filed oversight resolutions. Conduct is bill-based, not floor votes.
